notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
CHAOS class TXT query against version.bind fingerprints the exact DNS server software version without standard security monitoring triggering. Returns the BIND version string or equivalent for other DNS implementations.

=== CHAINING ===
Passive fingerprint → look up version in CVE databases → identify if unpatched vulnerabilities exist → plan targeted exploitation if applicable.

=== DETECTION EVASION ===
CHAOS class queries are not logged by most standard DNS monitoring tools which focus on IN class queries. Administrators who disabled version reporting return REFUSED or a generic string.
